source: in-situ PSF v2 (2026-11-15, out/psf_v2/psf_refit.py) of /mnt/data/dmdsf/bn_dnapaint/1809/cover1/2/simflux_5.5ms_500mW.tif: torch_psf.InSituEstimator, vectorial Zernike Noll 5-21, single raw frames < 30000, ROI 15, 8000 train / 4000 held-out spots, median-deviance overlap rejection, refine=False, no blur, default dipole model (no photoselection terms), focus fixed at 0.2 um (see out/psf_v2/STATUS.md), branch A_neutral; camera v2 (gain 0.4256 e/ADU from the white-noise photon transfer, sample-free offset map); optics / pattern blocks copied from calib_1809_2_psf3d.json

camera.note: v2 2026-11-15 (out/psf_v2): gain 0.4256 e/ADU = joint white-noise photon transfer of 1809_2, 0.5 nM, 2.5 nM m2, 20 nM m2 (power of same-SIM-step frame differences above the OTF cutoff vs level; leave-one-out 0.424-0.428); the stored 0.56 came from binning by absolute level, which mixes in offset fixed-pattern pixels. Offset map = camera fixed pattern (own map, clean) + global 103.93 ADU; offset / read-noise split not identifiable without dark frames: median read noise fixed at 0.9 e (stored value; the lab offset 106.4 would imply ~1.35 e); per-pixel read noise re-estimated with the new gain (high-passed temporal variance)

pattern.steps: frame%6; angle=step//3; I = A*relint*(1+depth*cos(k.r - phase - dphi(t))), r=(x=col,y=row) px
pattern.depth_note: 0.925/0.955: cross-cycle estimator, nn_overlap>=3 subset (real 0.920-0.927 / 0.953-0.954); bench v2 shows this subset within ~+0.02 of truth (worker, 2026-11-08). step_fit regression depth is diluted and must not be written to pattern files.

psf_v2.note: per-pattern-angle photoselection (psf_dipole_M_angle) and line blur of the psf3d calibration are not carried over
